# MediaPipe Selfie Segmentation

This directory contains the browser runtime files from
[MediaPipe Selfie Segmentation version 0.1.1675465747](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mediapipe/selfie_segmentation/v/0.1.1675465747).

The package is licensed under Apache-2.0. It is served locally so camera frames
remain in the browser; only the model runtime files are loaded from this site.
